Here is your medicine list. Take hydrochlorothiazide 37.5 mg by mouth once a week.
Take lisinopril 5 mg by mouth once a week.
Take amlodipine 7.5 mg by mouth three times a day, which is 22.5 mg a day.
Take simvastatin 15 mg by mouth once a week.

Please do not take any extra medicine today unless your doctor or pharmacist tells you to. Ask your doctor and pharmacist your questions before you change how you take any medicine.

Here is your medicine list.

Take hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg by mouth once a day, which is 25 mg a day.

Take lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once a day, which is 10 mg a day.

Take amlodipine 2.5 mg by mouth once a day, which is 2.5 mg a day.

Please ask your care team your questions.
